name: purisev
description: Plugins for coding agents, maintained by purisev.

plugins.name: openviking-memory
plugins.description: Long-term semantic memory backed by OpenViking: the official upstream Claude Code plugin, pinned to an OpenViking release. Recall on each prompt, capture per turn, commit by token threshold, before compaction and at session end, plus OpenViking's MCP tools.

plugins.name: ov-wiki
plugins.description: An agent-authored Markdown wiki stored in OpenViking: init, ingest, query, lint and recover. Depends on openviking-memory for the OpenViking tools.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Third-party: blader/humanizer, pinned to a release.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task. Hooks turn it on in every session and subagent. Third-party: DietrichGebert/ponytail, pinned to a release.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Skills for infrastructure CLIs: Ansible, Helm, Terraform in preflight mode, Terramate templating and VictoriaMetrics MetricsQL.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Write, debug and run Playwright browser tests, drive a browser through Playwright MCP, and extract data from JS-rendered pages. Third-party: Clawic's Playwright skill, pinned to a commit.
